args.sql:
SELECT signalregistry, snrratio, noisefloordbm, 
       snrratio - 0.1 * ABS(noisefloordbm) AS snqi,
       CASE WHEN snrratio - 0.1 * ABS(noisefloordbm) > 0 THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS analyzable
FROM signals LIMIT 5;

-- Step 1: Add the analyzable flag column to signals table
ALTER TABLE signals ADD COLUMN analyzable BOOLEAN;

-- Step 2: Set the flag for all existing signals based on SNQI
UPDATE signals 
SET analyzable = CASE 
    WHEN snrratio - 0.1 * ABS(noisefloordbm) > 0 THEN TRUE 
    ELSE FALSE 
END;

-- Step 3: Create the trigger function
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION set_analyzable_flag()
RETURNS TRIGGER AS $$
BEGIN
    NEW.analyzable := CASE 
        WHEN NEW.snrratio - 0.1 * ABS(NEW.noisefloordbm) > 0 THEN TRUE 
        ELSE FALSE 
    END;
    RETURN NEW;
END;
$$ LANGUAGE plpgsql;

-- Step 4: Create the trigger to fire on INSERT or UPDATE
CREATE TRIGGER trg_set_analyzable_flag
BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE ON signals
FOR EACH ROW
EXECUTE FUNCTION set_analyzable_flag();
